- (localVarname).match => the string to match

description.zh: 必須在"光暈戰記遊戲設定"中設定攜帶式的道具種類，才能有效執行這個檢查。

label.en: Include picking up store items on the ground
label.zh: 包括從地上撿起來的商店道具

description.en: When trigger is about the happen, delay the trigger of checks and actions.
description.zh: 當觸發條件符合時，是否延後一段時間再進行觸發檢查和動作。

description.en:
If true, this TRIGGER will be disabled after this.trigger() is called.
This is useful when the TRIGGER is only meanningful for the first trigger, like detecting when another event is triggered, or detecting when a hero dies.
description.zh:
若為真，則這個觸發將在this.trigger()被呼叫後停用。
這個設定在只有第一次觸發時有意義的觸發上特別有用，比如偵測其他事件被觸發的時候，或偵測遊戲中某角色死亡的時候。

description.en:

description.en: If set, the event will trigger only when the actor matches one of the expressions.

description.en:
If activated, this patrol point will be random picked from a list of locations.
* randomly picked everytime the actor patrols to this point.
description.zh:
若啟用隨機位置，則這個巡邏點會由以下設定的位置中隨機取得。
* 每次角色巡邏到這一點都會隨機取位置。

description.en: The direction that the actor faces when staying on this patrol point.
description.zh: 角色在這個巡邏點停留時的面向角度。

description.en: If checked, the actor will travel all previous points, and stay on this point forever.
description.zh: 若勾選，則角色在巡邏到這個地點後，就會一直停留在這裏。

description.en: If set to true, the AI will skip this point when no path can be found.
description.zh: 角色會在無法找到前往的路線時，跳過這個巡邏點，前往下個巡邏點。

description.en: The duration that the actor stays on this patrol point.
description.zh: 角色在這個巡邏點停留的時間。

description.en:
If not 0, the location will be be picked randomly in the range of the center location(x,y).
The picked location will be walkable from the center.
description.zh:
若範圍大於0，則遊戲中會選擇一個離中心點(x,y)設定範圍內的隨機座標。
系統在選擇座標時，會確保這個點是可以從中心點走過去的。
